usage_note: Base chance is the character's starting percentage before any skill points from professions or personal skills are added. Roll D100 equal to or under the total chance to succeed. 'Various' skills have specialties in parentheses; only the named specialty gains the listed rating, all others sit at the base chance.

entries.name: Appraise
entries.description: Judging the value of an item or determining some aspects of its capabilities that are not immediately apparent.

entries.name: Art (various)
entries.description: Painting, drawing, sculpture, photography, or another form of visual art. Each type of art is a specialty (e.g. Art (Photography), Art (Painting)). Suggested specialties include Architecture, Calligraphy, Film, Painting, Photography, Sculpture, etc.

entries.name: Artillery (various)
entries.description: Using heavy mounted weaponry, such as catapults, cannons, missile launchers, etc. Each type of artillery weapon is a specialty, such as Cannon, Rocket Launcher, Siege Engine, etc.

entries.name: Bargain
entries.description: Negotiating financial matters successfully. A successful use of this skill lowers the price of an item from one price range (unattainable > priceless > expensive > reasonable > inexpensive > cheap > free) to the one below, at the gamemaster's discretion.

entries.name: Brawl
entries.description: Hitting someone in hand-to-hand combat, whether with a punch, head butt, kick, or even bite. A successful Brawl attack does 1D3 points of damage to an opponent.

entries.name: Climb
entries.description: Scaling a wall, rope, or other difficult surface.

entries.name: Command
entries.description: Leading a small-to-large group of followers in combat or through some other difficult activity requiring discipline and coordinated actions. If this skill fails, everyone is on their own and does not work together effectively.

entries.name: Craft (various)
entries.description: The creation of some physical item for use, like woodworking, blacksmithing, sewing, cooking. Craft is generally more practical than Art, though less likely to achieve fame and recognition. Each type of Craft skill is a specialty.

entries.name: Demolition
entries.description: Setting and detonating explosives to achieve maximum effect. Anyone can pull a pin on a grenade; use Demolition to jury-rig a bomb from household chemicals or to set explosives in the right places to bring a building down.

entries.name: Disguise
entries.description: Concealing identity or appearance, or using some combination of makeup and costume to appear as someone or something else.

entries.name: Dodge
entries.description: Avoiding injury from a physical attack.

entries.name: Drive (various)
entries.description: Piloting a ground vehicle. For characters from the modern world, Drive is 20%; for others it begins at 01%. Each type of vehicle (Automobile, Cart, Chariot, Truck, etc.) is a specialty.

entries.name: Energy Weapon (various)
entries.description: Pointing and shooting an energy weapon at a target. Each type of Energy Weapon skill is a specialty, such as Energy Pistol and Energy Rifle.

entries.name: Etiquette
entries.description: Knowing what to say and how to behave in a social situation, as well as understanding the various niceties of a particular social class.

entries.name: Fast Talk
entries.description: Talking one's way out of a rough situation or bluffing when there is no time for a reasoned argument or debate.

entries.name: Fine Manipulation
entries.description: Finger dexterity, particularly important for disassembling things in a hurry or completing complex tasks requiring hand coordination. This might be used for picking locks.

entries.name: Firearm (various)
entries.description: Pointing and shooting a firearm at a target. Each type of Firearm skill is a specialty, such as Machine Gun, Pistol, Revolver, Rifle, Shotgun, and Submachine Gun.

entries.name: First Aid
entries.description: Treating minor injuries. For characters from the modern or future eras, the base skill is 30%; for historical periods it's INT×1. Each successful use restores 1D3 hit points to a wounded character. A special success restores 1D3+3 hit points.

entries.name: Fly
entries.description: If the character has a technological means of flying (a jet pack, for example), the chance is DEX×½. If it's a natural ability (like wings) the chance is DEX×4. Basic flight doesn't require a roll; the skill is for use with maneuvers, in combat, and performing complex flying stunts.

entries.name: Gaming
entries.description: Knowledge of the rules and odds of various games of chance (cards, dice, etc.) and winning.

entries.name: Grapple
entries.description: Wrestling or other means of open-handed combat relying on leverage and positioning to maneuver or immobilize an opponent.

entries.name: Heavy Machine (various)
entries.description: Handling and maintaining a heavy machine, like a factory press, a thresher, etc. Each different type of Heavy Machine skill is a specialty.

entries.name: Heavy Weapon (various)
entries.description: Pointing and shooting a heavy weapon. Each different type of Heavy Weapon skill is a specialty, such as Bazooka, Heavy Machinegun, Mini-gun, Rocket Launcher, etc.

entries.name: Hide
entries.description: Concealing oneself or an item from view. Often used in conjunction with Stealth.

entries.name: Insight
entries.description: Evaluating another character's concealed thoughts and/or motives based on subliminal clues. In some settings this might have specialties like Insight (Elves) or Insight (Aliens).

entries.name: Jump
entries.description: Leaping over an obstacle or across a span. Success for most humans usually equals a jump of roughly three meters horizontally or one meter vertically.

entries.name: Knowledge (various)
entries.description: Familiarity with a specific branch of study. For characters from the modern or future eras, the base skill is 05%; for historical periods it's 01%. Each type of Knowledge skill is a specialty. Specialties are numerous, and include Anthropology, Archaeology, Area (a region), Folklore, Group (an organization), History, Linguistics, Literature, Mythology, Occult, Politics, Streetwise, etc.

entries.name: Language (various)
entries.description: Speaking and understanding a language. Language (Own) is a character's 'own' native language and begins at INT×5. Generally, player characters do not need to make Language rolls to converse in their native languages with other speakers of the same language. Language (Other) is another language and begins at 00%. Each other Language skill is a specialty.

entries.name: Listen
entries.description: Hearing a noise or faint sound, such as someone sneaking by or a monster approaching.

entries.name: Literacy (various)
entries.description: Mainly appropriate for settings where education is not commonplace. Understanding and comprehension of what the character is reading. In settings where literature is not assumed, this might begin at 00%.

entries.name: Martial Arts
entries.description: Using disciplined trained fighting techniques to deliver more powerful blows against an opponent or to block with one's hands and feet without taking damage. The gamemaster may restrict who can use Martial Arts and adjust starting skill levels. Unlike other skills, Martial Arts is not rolled separately: if a character makes a Brawl attack and also rolls under Martial Arts skill, the damage die (but not the damage bonus) is doubled. When parrying a melee weapon with the Brawl skill, the character ignores 3 points of damage.

entries.name: Medicine
entries.description: Treatment of serious medical conditions through pharmaceutical, therapeutic, or surgical means. For characters from the modern or future eras, the base skill is 05%; for historical periods it's 00%. This is a time-consuming process and does not restore hit points immediately.

entries.name: Melee Weapon (various)
entries.description: Using a hand-to-hand (melee) weapon in combat, including striking a target and parrying attacks. Each type of Melee Weapon skill is a specialty, such as Axe, Club, Dagger, Flail, Hammer, Mace, Polearm, Spear, Staff, Sword, etc.

entries.name: Missile Weapon (various)
entries.description: Aiming and hitting a target with a 'hand-powered' weapon. Each type of Missile Weapon skill is a specialty, such as Bow, Crossbow, Spear, etc.

entries.name: Navigate
entries.description: Charting and following a path through recognizable landmarks, constellations, or using a map to find a course.

entries.name: Perform (various)
entries.description: Entertaining or performing in some fashion, whether through music, acting, acrobatics, comedy, etc. Each type of Perform is a specialty.

entries.name: Persuade
entries.description: Using logic, reason, and emotional appeal to convince someone to agree to a specific course of action or avenue of thought. Unlike Fast Talk, Persuade takes time, supporting arguments, and a willing audience.

entries.name: Pilot (various)
entries.description: Operating an air, sea, or space vehicle. Each vehicle type is a specialty, and some vehicles may require multiple pilots to operate.

entries.name: Projection
entries.description: If powers (magic, super, psychic, etc.) are used in a game, this is the ability to direct a powered attack at a target.

entries.name: Psychotherapy
entries.description: Using psychiatry and psychological analysis to determine a patient's psychological issues and address them through treatment. First Aid heals the body, but Psychotherapy heals the mind. This is a lengthy process handled through multiple sessions and in-depth personal evaluation and counseling. In historical periods this is spiritual counseling.

entries.name: Repair (various)
entries.description: Fixing something broken, jammed, disassembled, or otherwise inoperable. Each type of Repair is a specialty, such as Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical, Structural, Quantum, etc.

entries.name: Research
entries.description: Using a source of references (library, newspaper archive, computer network, the internet, wizard's grimoire, etc.) to discover desired pieces of information.

entries.name: Ride (various)
entries.description: Riding an animal and controlling it in difficult situations. Each type of animal (horse, dragon, giant owl, etc.) is a specialty.

entries.name: Science (various)
entries.description: Expertise in a field of study from the 'hard sciences.' Each type of Science skill is a specialty, such as Astronomy, Biology, Botany, Chemistry, Genetics, Geology, Mathematics, Meteorology, Physics, Zoology, etc.

entries.name: Sense
entries.description: A combination of scent, taste, and touch; being able to detect subtle or hidden things with these senses.

entries.name: Shield (various)
entries.description: Parrying a blow with a shield. Each type of Shield skill is a specialty, such as Buckler, Energy, Full, Half, Heater, Hoplite, Kite, Round, etc.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.description: Feats of prestidigitation and misdirection, such as picking pockets, palming coins, card tricks, and sleight-of-hand illusions.

entries.name: Spot
entries.description: Detecting those things difficult to notice or otherwise hidden.

entries.name: Status (various)
entries.description: Social standing, or the ability to manipulate one's social environment in a favorable manner, such as borrowing money, gaining favors, impressing others, etc. Each type of Status skill is a specialty. Specialties might include City (a particular city), Group (one group or organization), High Society, Religion, Species (a particular species), etc.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.description: Sneaking around to avoid detection or making otherwise concealed and furtive movements.

entries.name: Strategy
entries.description: Tactical assessment of a situation and constructing an optimal response, gaining insight into the conditions on a battlefield or the tactics the enemy will use. Often utilized in military or political situations.

entries.name: Swim
entries.description: Guiding oneself through the water with the intent of movement or prevention of drowning.

entries.name: Teach
entries.description: Imparting knowledge to others.

entries.name: Technical Skill (various)
entries.description: Use of a sophisticated piece of equipment or technical process. The base chance varies by setting and should be determined by the gamemaster, as appropriate. Each type of Technical skill is a specialty, such as Computer Programming, Computer Use, Electronics, Robotics, Sensor Systems, Siege Engines, Traps, etc.

entries.name: Throw
entries.description: Aiming and tossing something (dart, football, baseball, rock, hat, etc.) through the air towards a target. Unlike the Missile Weapon skill, this is a catch-all for anything that isn't specifically a weapon, and a successful roll doesn't necessarily damage an opponent.

entries.name: Track
entries.description: Following a trail of footprints, spoor, etc. in either direction.
